parameters.name: jql
parameters.value: project = KAN AND issuetype = Story AND (labels IS EMPTY OR labels NOT IN (ai-new, ai-analysing, ai-analysis-approved, ai-tests-approved, ai-done, ai-rejected)) ORDER BY created ASC
